# HResourceDetail

> A resource introduction with breadcrumbs, state, metadata, and tabbed details.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This describes repository source for version 0.5.0. Match documentation to your installed source/release.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HResourceDetail` from `@hearth-ui/vue`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-resource-detail>`.
- Constructor: `HearthResourceDetailElement` from `@hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Layouts.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HResourceDetail.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- Supply data, actions, and one named slot per tab value. Without tabs, the default slot is used.
- Breadcrumb navigate(id) and active-tab changes are requests to the host app. The recipe does not fetch the resource.

## Public API

title, description, activeTab, status: string · breadcrumbs: NavItem[] · fields: DescriptionItem[] · tabs: TabItem[] · tone: Tone

A `?` marks optional source props. Props with defaults may be omitted. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    breadcrumbs?: NavItem[];
    fields?: DescriptionItem[];
    tabs?: TabItem[];
    activeTab?: string;
    status?: string;
    tone?: Tone;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{ breadcrumbs: () => [], fields: () => [], tabs: () => [], tone: "neutral" }
```

### Events

navigate(id), update:activeTab(value)

```ts
type Emits = {
    navigate: [
        id: string
    ];
    "update:activeTab": [
        value: string
    ];
};
```

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose argument arrays in `event.detail`. Listen on the element. Native events such as `click` retain their normal payloads. The elements package provides framework-independent DOM event types.

### Slots

actions, summary, default or a named slot per tab.value

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Web components do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base

Use `hearth-resource-detail::part(part-name)` for an exposed part or inherited `--h-*` tokens for shared styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export interface NavItem {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    icon?: string;
    href?: string;
    badge?: string | number;
    disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface DescriptionItem {
    key: string;
    label: string;
    value?: TableCell;
    href?: string;
}

export type TableCell = string | number | boolean | null | undefined;

export interface TabItem {
    value: string;
    label: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
}

export type Tone = "neutral" | "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info";
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HResourceDetail } from '@hearth-ui/vue';
import '@hearth-ui/vue/styles.css';
const fields = [{key:'version',label:'Version',value:'1.0.0'}];
const tabs = [{value:'overview',label:'Overview'}];
</script>

<template>
  <HResourceDetail title="Photo library" :fields="fields" :tabs="tabs" status="Healthy" tone="success"><template #overview><p>Application details go here.</p></template></HResourceDetail>
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point. For field submission, use an owning native form; the auth page already contains its own form.

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

This is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Initial array/object properties are assigned before connection to establish reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@hearth-ui/elements';
import '@hearth-ui/elements/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-resource-detail');
Object.assign(element, {
  "title": "Photo library",
  "status": "Healthy",
  "tone": "success",
  "fields": [
    {
      "key": "version",
      "label": "Version",
      "value": "1.0.0"
    }
  ],
  "tabs": [
    {
      "value": "overview",
      "label": "Overview"
    }
  ]
});

element.innerHTML = "<p slot=\"overview\">Application details go here.</p>"; // Static example markup only; never inject untrusted HTML.

mount.append(element);
```

- [HTabs](../tabs/llms.txt): Tabs with roving focus, arrow/Home/End keys, and properly associated panels.
